v4 Corrections Applied

Methodology

Analysis uses SRTM1 (1 arc-second, ~30m) elevation data with 4/3 Earth radius propagation model. Each site is evaluated along 16 radials at 5 distance bands (2, 4, 6, 8, 10 km) for 80 sample paths per site. Fresnel zone clearance is calculated at F1 for both CBRS 3.625 GHz and 6 GHz UNII-5 bands.

Tier classification is based on CBRS extended-range (6-10km) pass rate: Tier 1 (80%+), Tier 2 (60-80%), Tier 3 (80%+ near-range only), Tier 4 (below thresholds). A path "passes" if it achieves 60%+ F1 clearance.

BSL counts are assigned by nearest-site at 5km (hybrid scenario) and 10km (optimistic scenario) radius.

v4 Note: All coordinates verified against ASR/ELNK records. Real tower heights applied. This is a desktop analysis using 30m resolution terrain data. Field validation with drive tests is required before final design commitment. Sites with low Fresnel clearance may benefit from repositioning or height adjustments.
